name: signett
description: Build reliable WebMCP tools that let AI agents use your product safely.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/bundle-declarations.mjs && node scripts/copy-eval-runtime.mjs
scripts.tutorial:test: npm run build && vitest run --root ../.. fixtures/hello-world/src/greeting.test.ts
scripts.lint: npm run build && npm run lint:source
scripts.test:reference: npm run build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd ../../fixtures/cypress-realworld-app build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd ../../fixtures/cypress-realworld-app start-server-and-test start:webmcp:ci 'http://localhost:3000|http://localhost:3001' test:webmcp
scripts.test:reference:repeat: npm run build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd ../../fixtures/cypress-realworld-app build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd ../../fixtures/cypress-realworld-app start-server-and-test start:webmcp:ci 'http://localhost:3000|http://localhost:3001' test:webmcp:repeat
scripts.test:reference:native:probe: npm run build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd ../../fixtures/cypress-realworld-app build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd ../../fixtures/cypress-realworld-app start-server-and-test start:webmcp:ci 'http://localhost:3000|http://localhost:3001' test:webmcp:native:probe
scripts.test:reference:native: npm run build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd ../../fixtures/cypress-realworld-app build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd ../../fixtures/cypress-realworld-app start-server-and-test start:webmcp:ci 'http://localhost:3000|http://localhost:3001' test:webmcp:native
